text.p: Results of four-day English county championship cricket matches ending on Monday:
At Ilford: Yorkshire beat Essex by two wickets. Essex 297 and 312, Yorkshire 334 and 277-8 (D.Byas 89, D.Lehmann 81; P.Such 5-94).
At Cardiff: Glamorgan beat Durham by an innings and 8 runs. Glamorgan 597-8 declared, Durham 345 and 244 (J.Morris 149; Waqar Younis 4-56).
At Lord's: Middlesex beat Northamptonshire by an innings and 57 runs. Middlesex 531, Northamptonshire 216 and 258 (D.Ripley 51 not out; P.Tufnell 4-64).
At Leicester: Leicestershire v Lancashire - match drawn. Lancashire 373 and 425-5 declared, Leicestershire 468 and 247-5 (V.Wells 107).
At Worcester: Worcestershire v Somerset - match drawn.
At Southampton: Hampshire v Warwickshire - match drawn.
